samples.summary: Lessons file is authored before implementation, contrary to the workflow in CLAUDE.md which places 'capture lessons in *-lessons.md' at step 6 (before merge, after the branch is implemented and reviewed).
samples.evidence: The paired todo file (docs/tasks/active/20260912-sheets-paste-merge-propagation-todo.md) shows nearly all plan items unchecked (only 'Read paste / moveRangeTo / the merge helpers and the #941 review' is checked), yet the lessons file already asserts conclusions like 'PR #941 got this right' and 'Same invariant, different gesture, different answer' as settled findings. CLAUDE.md's Task Workflow (line 68) says to 'capture lessons in *-lessons.md' at step 6, after implementation and review are complete — this lessons file reads as pre-implementation research notes rather than lessons from doing the work.
